correctness.rationale: The 3D model’s predator-free Jacobian is triangular and has predator diagonal entries beta_J F(H)H and beta_A H. The time-ordered Jacobian product gives the exact stage-specific Floquet multipliers. For each positive periodic orbit the multiplicative prey ratios telescope; strict concavity of log(exp(u)-sigma) for sigma>0 gives a strict geometric-product bound at matched equilibrium coefficients. Direct substitution into the original recurrence at sigma=1/4, r0=49/4 and exponential escape functions gives the exact period-two orbit. Exact symbolic multiplication of full Jacobians yields prey m=(7 log7-8)(log7-1)/8 in (0,3/4), juvenile 7/8 and adult 9/8. Equilibrium factors agree and exceed one because 27<49. The claim is local, outside the source’s increasing-offspring assumption.

value.rationale: The source’s central question is which prey stage supports predator invasion; its main thresholds assume monotone offspring and explicitly leave high-growth Ricker dynamics open. This result identifies an exact structural role of adult prey survival: on any nonconstant prey-only cycle equal equilibrium replacement factors conceal a strict juvenile invasion disadvantage, whereas sigma=0 would give equality. The explicit exact stable Ricker two-cycle displays genuinely opposite local outcomes 7/8 versus 9/8, with both equilibrium replacement factors exceeding one. This is a meaningful ecological stability boundary, not a mere parameter shift or reported simulation. Global persistence is explicitly not claimed.
